reuse.why: The actions share category selection and reuse budget, sheet, and undo helpers, but introduce separate group-note storage instead of using the existing notes model.

duplication.why: Repeated category queries are consolidated, but income eligibility remains repeated across callers and copyPreviousMonth retains independent hidden-category filtering.

placement.why: Budget policy belongs in actions.ts, but adding category_groups.notes creates a competing home for notes already owned by the notes table and API.

scope.why: The changes address the requested budget actions, although the additional notes column unnecessarily expands the persistence design.

maintainability.why: Competing note representations, an unrouted month-wide action, and a selector return type claiming unselected fields leave unclear ownership and contracts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The migration and getMonthActionCategories use category_groups.notes instead of the existing notes table used by server/notes/app.ts and CategoryGroupMenuModal.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining duplicated eligibility checks are explicit rather than renamed or reshaped to conceal duplication.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional SQL branch, while copyPreviousMonth continues selecting and filtering independently.
